name: isolved People Cloud
description:
The isolved People Cloud connector gives employees self-service access to their own HR data inside Claude. Check time off balances, submit requests, view pay history with full earnings and deduction detail, see withholding in plain language and review direct deposit splits with account numbers always masked.

For payroll teams, The Guardian analyzes every payroll run in real time, flags potential errors before the run closes and prepares fixes for administrator approval. Nothing commits without sign-off.

Authenticates via OAuth and only accesses data your role is authorized to see. Capabilities vary based on your organization's isolved configuration and enabled services.

_published_faq.name: How do I add isolved People Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add isolved People Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.myisolved.com/restmcp-prod/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the isolved People Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: isolved People Cloud provides these MCP tools: get_time_off_requests, get_time_off_summary, cancel_time_off_request, and submit_time_off_request.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to isolved People Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to isolved People Cloud in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does isolved People Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: isolved People Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
isolved People Cloud is developed by isolved. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
